title: A February of Music and Plans
narrative: In early February, you meet 美竹兰 again at the same café. She brings a notebook filled with lyrics and asks for your thoughts on a new song. You spend an hour going over the lines together, and she seems relieved to have a second opinion. Before leaving, she invites you to a small live show her band is playing at the end of the month. You agree to come and offer to help with simple setup if they need an extra pair of hands. The rest of the month passes with ordinary routines—commuting, errands, and keeping up with news about the virus—but the plan to see her perform gives the weeks a clearer shape.
consequence: You met 美竹兰 at the café as arranged. She shared her new lyrics, and you discussed the song's meaning and structure. Your feedback helped her decide on a few changes, and she invited you to Afterglow's live show later in February. You accepted and offered to help with setup, which she appreciated. The meeting strengthened your friendship and gave you a concrete plan for the month.

relationshipUpdates.detail: Met at the café, discussed her new song lyrics, and she invited you to Afterglow's live show.

newsTranslations.title: Epidemic Command Center Coordinates Prevention
newsTranslations.description: Taiwan's epidemic command center coordinates information and supplies across departments, and schools and hospitals adjust entry rules. Communities begin registering mask needs and home care arrangements.

newsTranslations.title: After the Election, the KMT and DPP Continue to Debate Cross-Strait Policy
newsTranslations.description: After 蔡英文's re-election, the DPP lists defense and foreign cooperation as policy priorities. KMT legislators demand that the government explain cross-strait relations and trade arrangements, and the post-election debate continues in the Legislative Yuan and local councils.

newsTranslations.title: 美竹兰 Proposes a New Public Arrangement
newsTranslations.description: 美竹兰 holds consultations with relevant people about preserving independent expression. Supporters begin organizing demands and contacts, while those who disagree ask for clarification on the source of resources and how they will be implemented. These activities are changing local organizational ties.
